notes.title: First Patch! With tasty fixes and adjustments
notes.notes:
The release has already been a couple of days and we have been constantly updating the game with severe fixes and adjustments!
Here is a list with the most important fixes and changes:


 [Fixed] Level Socket - Candy Bay -  inside Terrain
 [Fixed] LevelEditor - Season Tool Panel Size 
 [Fixed] LevelEditor - Tool Panel Animation speed
 [Fixed] Sugar Hills - Blocked Tiles for Paths and Buildings
 [Fixed] LevelEditor - CookieToolbar - Split ratio of the Buttons
 [Fixed] OverworldMap - Open Map while not in Overworld
 [Fixed] Overworld Biom Name - End Biom -> Trick & Treasts -> Tricky Treats
 [Fixed] Savannah Collision Sounds -> Too Loud
 [Fixed] Wrong Music playing after coming back from Campaigne to Overworld - Wasnt reproducable at least
 [Fixed] Upload Levels to correct Workshop Branch
 [Fixed] The last bonus levels in Sugar Hills can now be unlocked
 [Fixed] Endless spinning on zimtstern bug :(
 [Fixed] Browser - UI Panel Overlaps
 [Fixed] Bubble Sound playing Globally
 [Fixed] Lag Spike on Loading Biom
 [Fixed] Progressgates include Bonus Level
 [Fixed] Campfire Burned Mallow after a delay
 [Fixed] Browser Slots - Displayname auto resize
 [Fixed] Global Level Count - Displaying the level count including credits and main menu scene instread of winnable levels only
 [Fixed] Gate Sound appearing on Fast Travel
 [Fixed] Overworld Map overlapping Resume button
 [Fixed] HeartParticles wrong Layer on Overworld
 [Fixed] Browser Info Panel -> Delete Button showing Text : "Duplicate" instead of "Delete"
 [Fixed] Level unsaved message triggers now only when changes are not saved yet
 [Fixed] Cinnamon roll don't really destroy cookies on border
 [Fixed] Filter Button Consistency
 [Fixed] Small Browser UI Changes
 [Fixed] Browser all tab does not load the files when no level got downloaded yet
 [Fixed] Downloaded level don't always get properly loaded
 [Fixed] Missing correct Level Previews on several Level Sockets inside Overworld
 [Fixed] Searchbar function in local browser
 
 [Changed] Is Downloaded Icon
 [Changed] Filter & Tags Panel
 [Changed] Upload Window Layout
 
 [Added] Broser Slots - Smooth Loading Animation
 [Added] Slot Symbols for -> Downloaded, Downloadable etc
 
 [Removed] Deprecated Author Field inside Editor -> Steam username will be used now



We are still working on more fixes so feel free to reach out to us, if you encounter critical bugs and more ^_^
Hope you all have fun playing our cute puzzles and enjoy a nice roasted S'More ❤️
See you next time!

notes.title: Final Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Hello fellow Mallows :3

We are finally bringing you a new content update for our game One S'More!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366893/211ee6d43788ee68627bea04faa687e9c3347083.png

This will be the last content update before we are going to work on the release content for september 23rd. 
In this Update, we changed quite a lot of things and we are excited to hear what you think of it!
We replaced a few of the last levels of each Biom and adjusted the overall campaign to ensure a more dynamic experience and a better learning curve.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44366893/0de606cca73e235b4767b771caa7efcabf28602c.png

We cant wait to hear your feedback!
If you want to stay up to date, share your own creations with our ingame editor and to let us know what you think about the game, please join our community server on discord.

Discord Server

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hello fellow Mallows!
We just uploaded our second patch for the One S'More Demo. This Patch features the new Rewind/Undo button, a complete UI overhaul and more! Feel free to send us Feedback via our social media, discord or with our ingame feedback tool.

Tutorial		
	- [ Added ]	Rewind Tutorial
Levels		
	- [ Added ]	A button to rewind/undo your last action
	- [ Changed ]	Early levels are now easier
	- [ Removed ]	The hint button
Level Editor		
	- [ Added ]	Selecting and moving groups of cookies
Other		
	- [ Added ]	Direction preview when hovering over cookies
	- [ Changed ]	Updated the Main Menu
	- [ Changed ]	Complete UI overhaul
	- [ Changed ]	Water impact wave visuals
	- [ Changed ]	Overworld level numeration
	- [ Removed ]	Winter Skin of the Overworld and Character
	- [ Fixed ]	Some game breaking bugs
	- [ Fixed ]	Many Smaller bugs
	and a lot of other things...

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Hello fellow Mallows :3
We are excited to present you the first patch for our One S'more Demo. This Patch contains some redesigned levels, adjusted difficulty curves, quality of life improvements and much more!
Feel free to send us Feedback via our social media, discord or with our ingame feedback tool ^_^  Have a very nice and delicious 6th of december!


Tutorial
